gecx.title: A helpdesk that answers by voice.
gecx.lead: An internal support agent built on Gemini Enterprise CX, the Google Customer Experience platform. This page explains what it does and how it was put together. The demo sits at the end, once you know what you are testing.
gecx.fact1: Voice and text in the same session
gecx.fact2: Answers grounded in its own knowledge base
gecx.what.title: What it is
gecx.what.p1: Gemini Enterprise CX is the Google customer service platform. The agent is described in CX Agent Studio, receives its knowledge sources and the tools it may call, and becomes a published deployment. The browser talks to that deployment through the official web widget, which handles authorization, audio streaming and playback.
gecx.what.p2: The agent in this project is an internal helpdesk. It started as a proof of concept for first level support: portal access, password reset, a VPN that is down and the status of a ticket. When guidance does not solve the problem, it hands the case to a human queue.
gecx.who.title: Who it is for
gecx.who.text: Internal support teams that get the same requests every day and want that volume out of the human queue without losing the escalation path.
gecx.solves.title: What it solves
gecx.solves.text: Answers backed by real documents instead of generic text, one agent serving both voice and writing, and an explicit rule for when to stop trying and call a person.
gecx.how.title: How it works
gecx.how.s1.title: Authorization with no key in the page
gecx.how.s1.text: The Google SDK asks a token broker with reCAPTCHA for the token. This page stores no credential and never talks to the service API directly.
gecx.how.s2.title: One session, two modes
gecx.how.s2.text: Voice uses the CES bidirectional stream, with the microphone captured by the SDK itself. Text uses the chat path of the same session. Switching modes changes only the interface, never restarting the conversation.
gecx.how.s3.title: Knowledge base lookup
gecx.how.s3.text: Answers come from a data store indexed with the helpdesk material: portal access, identity, connectivity and handoff criteria. Each answer leans on that content instead of inventing the procedure.
gecx.how.s4.title: Tools and tickets
gecx.how.s4.text: The agent checks the status of a ticket and asks for confirmation before opening a new one. After an error nothing is resent automatically, because a request with no visible answer may already have run on the other side.
gecx.how.s5.title: When to call a person
gecx.how.s5.text: The agent hands over when the user asks for a person, when there is a security risk, when the problem is critical or when two attempts at guidance fail to solve the case.
gecx.how.s6.title: Language as an instruction
gecx.how.s6.text: Brazilian Portuguese, US English, Spanish from Spain and Italian are configured on the agent. Picking one in the selector goes out as a conversation instruction, not as a change of voice model and not as a translator.
gecx.stack.title: Stack
gecx.stack.i1: CES v1beta API. Agent, deployment, versions and sessions, all manageable over the API.
gecx.stack.i2: Agent instructions, supported languages, voice and safety rules.
gecx.stack.i3: Data store that indexes the knowledge base searched during the conversation.
gecx.stack.i4: Official Google web component: authorization, audio capture, streaming and events.
gecx.stack.i5: The interface of this page, with no framework: audio orb, states, custom chat and error recovery.
gecx.stack.i6: Classifies the SDK error codes and keeps a short log, only in browser memory.
gecx.limits.title: Limits and privacy
gecx.limits.i1: The data in this demo is fictional. Do not type a password, personal data or confidential information.
gecx.limits.i2: Each voice call is capped at four minutes, counted from the moment the connection is confirmed.
gecx.limits.i3: The handoff to a human agent is simulated. There is no real queue and no phone number.
gecx.limits.i4: Audio is processed by Google and the conversation may be logged, depending on the project settings.
gecx.limits.i5: The diagnostics log stays in this tab memory only. It keeps no audio, messages, names or tokens.
gecx.limits.i6: European Portuguese is not on the official voice list. Choosing Portuguese gives you the Brazilian Portuguese voice.
gecx.demo.title: Demo
gecx.demo.lead: Here is the agent. Pick voice to talk to it or chat to write. It is the same agent and the same conversation either way.
gecx.demo.langHintAuto: Speak in the language you want.
gecx.demo.chatEmpty:
Write to the same assistant.
Use fictional data only in this test.
gecx.demo.footnote: Use fictional data. Audio is processed by Google and the conversation may be logged. Using the service can generate costs.
gecx.help.p1: Click the phone and allow microphone access. Try: “Hi, this is Eduardo. I need help with VPN access.” Use headphones to avoid echo.
gecx.help.p2: You can ask for help, check a ticket or switch to Chat and write. The handoff to a human agent in this demo is simulated.
gecx.help.h3: Microphone and connection are different things
gecx.help.p3: The orb reacts to local capture and to the assistant audio. Movement is no guarantee of an answer from Google. The status line says when we are waiting. Muting lets you keep listening without sending your voice, and it does not pause the call timer.
gecx.help.p4: Each call is capped at four minutes from the moment it connects. The error message separates inactivity, microphone, access and limits whenever Google provides that detail. “Call again” starts a new conversation, without replaying requests and without opening the microphone until you click.
gecx.help.lang1: The selector sends a language preference as a conversation instruction. It does not switch the voice model and it is not a separate translator. On Automatic, just speak in the language you want. Behaviour depends on the agent instructions and on the languages it supports.
gecx.help.lang2: European Portuguese (pt-PT) is not on the official CX Agent Studio voice list. Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) is. Asking for European vocabulary does not guarantee a European accent. Written chat covers more languages through the Gemini models.
gecx.help.langGa: Generally available: Brazilian Portuguese; US English; French from France and Canada; German from Germany; Spanish from Spain and the US.
gecx.help.langPreview: Preview: English from the UK, Australia, Canada and India; Mexican Spanish; Dutch; Mandarin, Danish, Finnish, Hindi, Hinglish, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Marathi, Polish, Romanian, Spanglish, Swedish, Tamil, Telugu, Turkish and Vietnamese.
gecx.diag.text: Events from this page, kept in memory only. It includes no audio, messages, names, credentials or tokens. Copy this log if you need to report an error.
